title: Matting models
description: 12 matting models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.
html:
12 matting models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.

Input: one RGB image (trimap-guided models also a trimap: background / unknown / foreground). Output: an alpha matte [H, W] in [0, 1] at the input size: 1 = foreground (background removal, dichotomous / salient object segmentation).

Measured on RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130; fastforks bench MODEL --size HxW measures yours. The summary uses one input, 1080x1920: kernels time with its speed-up over the faster original run, and kernels peak reserved memory with its ratio to the smaller original one. Where measured (one variant per family), a variant's table also lists portable under torch.compile and the fp16 TensorRT engine of portable (export; memory: the engine's device memory + torch's peak). – = not measured. The accuracy column is lower-is-better (DIS-VD MAE).

Other devices: Apple M1 Pro 16 GB, NVIDIA L4, NVIDIA L40S, NVIDIA A10, NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB, NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000; across devices.
